resources.string: Tap your phone near the NFC payment tag
Every payment gets a safety check before it leaves your phone.
Your scan history will appear here.

SafePay Shield is a local safety assistance tool. It analyzes QR codes, UPI links, and NFC payment payloads on this device. Purpose and limitations: The app highlights possible payment risks, but cannot detect every scam and does not guarantee that a payment is safe or that fraud will be prevented. User responsibility: Confirm the payee, amount, and details yourself. Never share your UPI PIN, OTP, password, or biometric access. Third-party services: Payments are completed by banks and payment applications outside SafePay Shield control. Security limitations: Device compromise, malicious apps, incorrect input, unsupported payloads, and unavailable sensors can reduce accuracy or protection. Local data: History, trusted contacts, trusted merchants, and preferences are stored locally using encrypted Android storage. Risk analysis is assistance only; review warnings and make the final payment decision yourself.

Privacy information: Payment analysis uses local rules and on-device models. The app does not require a SafePay Shield account or send payment payloads to a SafePay Shield server. History, trusted contacts, trusted merchants, and preferences are stored locally. Sensitive preferences use Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage. Third-party payment apps may receive payment details only when you choose to open a payment handoff. No app can guarantee complete protection from fraud. Confirm the payee and amount before entering a UPI PIN or OTP.
